_doc: Config for `nix-switch-progress` — ONE copyable Konsole window (dark KDE-native) shown for any nix command build.sh wraps (programs/nix-switch-progress.nix). Driven by parsing `nix build --log-format internal-json` activity events into a real %. No labels/icons/colors hardcoded in the .nix/.mjs — all here (data-driven). Over SSH/TTY or with konsole absent the wrapper passes the command through unchanged (no window). Plan: user asked 2026-06-20, enriched 2026-07-04 (step phases, git/PSI/closure-size panel, persistent window with copy-log-on-failure), then collapsed from 3 windows (2 kdialog bars + Konsole) to this 1 Konsole window same day per direct request — all progress data (both bars, sizes, ETA) now lives in the one log stream instead.
title: Nix Switch Progress
